# L-C2 report — 2026-09-14

All six requested scope items are complete, in order: feature specifications
and resolver/time-axis tests, the 20-shot pilot, the 500-shot pellet census,
the gated 500-shot production fetch, `docs/LABELMAKER.md`, and this report.
Execution crossed midnight from September 13 to 14 on the login node
`stellar-vis2.princeton.edu`. No SLURM jobs were submitted.

Worktree: `/scratch/gpfs/nc1514/FusionAIHub-Ifix`; branch `recommender-LC2`;
base `72aef10c4db99e423a872b7d71c5434f6fe10447`.

Implementation commits:

- `9ea771c6950532b45ab76a22a9cfd8ac0319d310` — worktree MCP configuration using
  the existing shared IDEATE interpreter.
- `4271d62ceb6bb9b4b901e1ff09eb115c969e32b4` — actuator features, explicit CLI
  selection, preservation during atomic merges, and regression tests.
- `83d1fb034c87fc53a34d2159954be854c912813d` — restrict the opt-in historical reference test to its original measured points.
- Documentation and this report are delivered in the subsequent documentation
  commit, identified in the final delivery message.

Every commit uses the `labelmaker:` prefix and exact trailer
`Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.
No commit was made while the labelmaker suite was running.

## Production result

Availability means a stored record with at least two samples and a finite,
strictly increasing time axis. It is not a count of active actuators or labels.
The production command completed all 500 unique shots with four workers:
**2,614 new feature groups**, zero requested groups already present, and
886 recorded RF misses. Its exit code was 1 because the existing fetch script
returns 1 when any requested feature is unavailable; it completed all 500
shots and had no EFC, E-coil, or store-write failure. All misses were
`TreeNNF` (367) or `TreeNODATA` (519), not substituted zero series.

Production wall time, including wrapper startup and writes: **1,057.96 s**
(17 min 37.96 s); the fetch script's internal timer rounded to 1,042 s.

| Feature | Stored units | Present /500 | Missing causes |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `lh_power` | kW | 41 | TreeNNF: 300, TreeNODATA: 159 |
| `helicon_twapwr` | blank (raw) | 73 | TreeNNF: 67, TreeNODATA: 360 |
| `efc_n1_ka` | kA | 500 | none |
| `efc_a1_c_ka` | kA | 500 | none |
| `efc_a1_iu_ka` | kA | 500 | none |
| `efc_a1_il_ka` | kA | 500 | none |
| `ecoil_a` | A | 500 | none |

The exact added specs are the seven names in the preceding table. All have `kind="scalar"`, `sources=("fdp",)`, and `step=0.0`.

| Spec | Locator / provenance and interpretation |
|---|---|
| `lh_power` | `\RF::LH_POWER`, alias of `\RF::TOP.LHCD:LH_POWER`; source kW retained. Net coupled versus forward power is unconfirmed; `LH_INTOD3` routing remains unchecked. |
| `helicon_twapwr` | `\RF::TWAPWR`; blank source unit field on probe shots 200009/201068. No scale or clipping. TWAPWR/TWAPWRC/TWAPWRO meanings remain unconfirmed. No RF metadata calibration was established that would justify inventing a unit. |
| `efc_a1_c_ka` | `\OPERATIONS::CN1IAMP`, recorded Amps divided by 1000. |
| `efc_a1_iu_ka` | `\OPERATIONS::IUN1IAMP`, recorded Amps divided by 1000. |
| `efc_a1_il_ka` | `\OPERATIONS::ILN1IAMP`, recorded Amps divided by 1000. |
| `efc_n1_ka` | `max(efc_a1_c_ka,efc_a1_iu_ka,efc_a1_il_ka)`. Every component is required on the same clock; any nonfinite component produces NaN. Amplitude alone is not correction or calibrated resonant magnetic field. |
| `ecoil_a` | PTDATA `ecoil`, source `a` stored as A without scaling. Available on all 500, so no fallback was needed. `ECOILFWDCL`/`ECOILREVCL` are V-valued signals and cannot substitute for an A-valued current without calibration. Current Saturation remains a later definition/label task. |

Tree selection now comes from the qualified locator, covering `rf`,
`operations`, `pellet`, and `d3d` as well as existing EFIT/ZIPFIT trees.
EFIT's separate time-node fallback is restricted to EFIT. All scalar clocks
pass through `_scalar_axes` and `_checked_time` and are stored in seconds;
no resampling or extrapolation is used for these new specs. Known physical
units are checked before relabelling/conversion. The store's existing
float64 `xdata` / float32 `ydata` convention is retained for new datasets.

All 500 stored EFC maxima were checked against the three stored components,
including exact clock equality and NaN propagation. All **103 resolved
pilot feature records** have byte-identical `xdata` and `ydata` in production.

## Wait gate and preservation

The exact gate was `pgrep -fa 'labelmaker.run events'`, invoked without a
shell command containing its own match string. First check:
`2026-09-14T04:17:50.840031+00:00`; return code 1; empty stdout and stderr.
**Held for 0 seconds**: one poll, **0.075017 s** total check time.
The 60-second polling interval and three-hour limit were implemented but
were not needed. The production command started only after this clear result.

Every pre-existing dataset in all 500 files was hashed before and after:
**25,190 datasets in 11,763 groups**, with
identical raw array bytes, dtype, shape, dataset attributes, compression/chunk
settings, and group attributes. The audit also checked that the only new
group names were the seven requested features and that each contained only
`xdata` and `ydata`. File-level writer metadata and the `missing` map are
updated by the normal store contract; whole HDF5 file hashes are therefore
not the dataset-preservation test.

Each dataset fingerprint includes SHA-256 of its raw array bytes without a
dtype conversion. SHA-256 of the canonical JSON containing all existing
fingerprints (including metadata), before and after:

| After | `528b81e9776ceef10d1b3d77c104160fc8ba57b593a02d2a425086877958e19d` |

## Pilot

The exact probe sample was reused: four shots per year, 2021–2025:
2021 = 185786, 186257, 186892, 187308;
2022 = 188734, 189836, 190730, 193354;
2023 = 193542, 195122, 196009, 196639;
2024 = 198351, 200009, 201068, 202180;
2025 = 202726, 203505, 204114, 204925.

`python -m labelmaker.run features` wrote only beneath `/tmp/lc2/pilot`.
The command exited 0 with 20 partial shots because neither RF feature exists
on every shot. Wall time was **59.65 s** (2.9825 s per selected shot with four
workers, distinct from each worker's per-shot wall time below).
LH 1/20, Helicon 2/20, and all EFC/E-coil features 20/20 reproduce the probe.
The pilot used the implementation before commit, so its manifest records
base SHA `72aef10`; production records implementation SHA `4271d62`.
The subsequent review fixes affect failure recovery/merge metadata and did
not alter the measured pilot values, as the byte comparison confirms.

## Pellet census

All **5,000 unique node/shot checks** were completed for the exact 500-shot
manifest (SHA-256 `a58c9c8983bab1c71d5ab74eb4949f86b0a7d06df7b0f1ff5a39132aee6ac2e2`).
Wall time: **1139.686 s** (18 min 59.686 s), four login-node workers.

The four LGI nodes had zero record bytes and zero segments on every shot,
with no unknown metadata reads. Verdict: **`no_data_in_corpus` for lithium
granules**. PCS candidates returned 2,024 records across six nodes; 976
reads were unknown (974 PTSERVER service-resolution failures and two
truncated PTDATA directories). Returned constant records count as records,
not as evidence of delivered material. No pellet label was derived.

LGI metadata uses the probe's FDP-configured `MdsSignal` / `MdsTreeRegistry`
path, inspecting `node.length` and `node.getNumSegments()` without requiring
waveform dimensions. PCS uses `fdp_probe.probe`, retaining only its metadata
summary and exact error; waveform arrays are not retained. Imports/fetches
occur only inside workers, after forking, to respect PTDATA's fork constraint.
The metadata operation per LGI point was:

```python
signal = MdsSignal("1", "pellet").sig
tree = MdsTreeRegistry().open_tree("pellet", shot, signal.treepath)
node = tree.getNode(point)
record_present = int(node.length) > 0 or int(node.getNumSegments()) > 0
```

## Commands and verification

All Python execution used the existing shared environments. No installs,
lock updates, environment edits, or main-checkout source edits were made.
The `/tmp/lc2/labelmaker.sh` wrapper executes this prefix from the worktree:

```bash
cd /scratch/gpfs/nc1514/FusionAIHub-Ifix
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src
export XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/lc2/cache PIP_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/lc2/pip-cache
export TMPDIR=/tmp/lc2 MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/lc2/matplotlib
pixi run --manifest-path /scratch/gpfs/nc1514/FusionAIHub/pyproject.toml \
  --frozen --no-install -e labelmaker ...
```

The main operation commands (baseline capture ran read-only during the census):

```bash
/tmp/lc2/labelmaker.sh fdp run python -m labelmaker.run features \
  --features lh_power helicon_twapwr efc_n1_ka \
    efc_a1_c_ka efc_a1_iu_ka efc_a1_il_ka ecoil_a \
  --shot-file /tmp/lc2/pilot-shots.txt --root /tmp/lc2/pilot \
  --workers 4 --run-id lc2-pilot

/tmp/lc2/labelmaker.sh fdp run python /tmp/lc2/pellet_census.py
# Baseline capture ran read-only during the census, before any production write:
/tmp/lc2/labelmaker.sh python /tmp/lc2/hash_features.py before
/tmp/lc2/labelmaker.sh python /tmp/lc2/fix_control_hashes.py
# After the census process completed:
/tmp/lc2/labelmaker.sh python /tmp/lc2/finalize_census.py
/tmp/lc2/labelmaker.sh python /tmp/lc2/wait_gate.py

/tmp/lc2/labelmaker.sh fdp run python scripts/labelmaker/fetch_features.py \
  --shot-file /scratch/gpfs/EKOLEMEN/nc1514/labelmaker/recommender_v1.txt \
  --features lh_power helicon_twapwr efc_n1_ka \
    efc_a1_c_ka efc_a1_iu_ka efc_a1_il_ka ecoil_a \
  --features-dir /scratch/gpfs/EKOLEMEN/nc1514/labelmaker/features \
  --workers 4 --retries 1

/tmp/lc2/labelmaker.sh python /tmp/lc2/hash_features.py after
/tmp/lc2/labelmaker.sh python /tmp/lc2/summarize_features.py \
  --root /scratch/gpfs/EKOLEMEN/nc1514/labelmaker/features \
  --shots /tmp/lc2/census-shots.json --output /tmp/lc2/production-summary.json
/tmp/lc2/labelmaker.sh python /tmp/lc2/audit_production.py
```

Pilot and production elapsed times were captured with `/usr/bin/time -f '%e'`;
logs and timing output were redirected to `/tmp/lc2`.

Failing tests were written before implementation: the initial actuator tests
produced **24 expected failures**, and the CLI/preservation regressions
produced **2 expected failures**. The initial focused run then passed 123
with 2 existing live-test skips. Independent review found component recovery
and retained-feature miss-map edge cases; both new tests were observed to
fail before fixing them, then the 49-test actuator/store run passed.
The reviewer approved those fixes before production.

Final review also found that the opt-in live smoke test assumed every
registered feature existed on the historical shot 185945. A live run
reproduced exactly `lh_power: TreeNNF` and `helicon_twapwr: TreeNNF` (1 failed
in 39.64 s). The test now names the original 19 measured reference points,
keeping its data, shape, time-axis, and resolver assertions. The corrected live test
passed (1 passed in 34.03 s, `-W error --run-live` under `fdp run`). The new
actuator features retain their separate failing-first tests, pilot and
500-shot validation. This test-only correction was made after production;
the full scoped labelmaker suite was rerun afterward. IDEATE source and its
configuration did not change after its green full-suite run.

```bash
PYTEST_ADDOPTS='-o cache_dir=/tmp/lc2/pytest-cache' \
/tmp/lc2/labelmaker.sh fdp run python -m pytest \
  tests/labelmaker/test_resolve_fdp.py::test_live_fetch_of_the_reference_points_for_one_shot \
  -q -W error --run-live
```

Final full-suite commands and results:

```bash
PYTEST_ADDOPTS='-o cache_dir=/tmp/lc2/pytest-cache' /tmp/lc2/labelmaker.sh python -m pytest tests/labelmaker -q -W error
# 1455 passed, 2 skipped in 248.74s; exit 0

HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src \
IDEATE_DATA_ROOT=/scratch/gpfs/EKOLEMEN/nc1514/ideate \
LABELMAKER_ROOT=/scratch/gpfs/EKOLEMEN/nc1514/labelmaker \
IDEATE_CORPUS=/scratch/gpfs/EKOLEMEN/foundation_model \
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TMPDIR=/tmp/lc2 MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/lc2/matplotlib \
/scratch/gpfs/nc1514/FusionAIHub/.pixi/envs/ideate-cpu/bin/python \
  -m pytest tests/ideate -q -W error
# 930 passed in 195.25s; exit 0
```

The two labelmaker skips are the existing opt-in live FDP tests; actual live
access was verified by the pilot and production run. After pytest's successful
summary, XRootD's process-exit finalizer prints the existing
`torch.distributed.reduce_op` FutureWarning; no test warning failed and the
process exit code is 0. This dependency was not edited or silenced.

Full Ruff command:

```bash
/tmp/lc2/labelmaker.sh python -m ruff check --no-cache \
  src/labelmaker tests/labelmaker scripts/labelmaker
```

Only the two brief-declared pre-existing findings remain in
`tests/labelmaker/data/make_tearing_dsm_golden.py`: SIM115 and UP031.
Ruff on every changed Python file passes. `git diff --check` passes.
Fourteen protected files under the explicitly forbidden paths, `data/labels/`,
and `docs/superpowers/plans/` were checked byte-for-byte against `72aef10`
and remain unchanged. Existing untracked LC2/LCprobe briefs/reports were not
staged or edited. No labels, heuristics, event pipelines, or phenomena
registries were changed.

## Deviations and assumptions

- The runner had no explicit feature-selection flag and required a model.
  `--features` was added and tested to perform the specified pilot without
  inventing a model. It is exclusive with `--models` and restricted to the
  features stage.
- Existing merges round-tripped untouched groups through NumPy, risking
  dtype/NaN-payload changes and dropping auxiliary datasets/metadata. Atomic
  merges now copy the original file and update only supplied groups. The
  production wrapper supplied only absent new feature names, without force.
- The copied `.mcp.json` pointed at the main checkout, causing the first
  IDEATE run's sole failure (929 passed, 1 failed). It now selects this
  worktree and the existing shared interpreter. This is isolated in
  `9ea771c`; its absolute worktree path must be adjusted if integrated into a
  different checkout. No IDEATE test was weakened or skipped.
- Shared Pixi commands use `--frozen --no-install` in addition to the brief's
  flags to honor the read-only environment constraint. Pytest initially
  reused its pre-existing worktree cache; that cache was subsequently moved
  intact to `/tmp/lc2/pytest-cache`. Runtime artifacts are not committed.
- The baseline captured all 500 shots, but an initial ten-shot control
  selection hit a shot without `pinj_total`. Controls were selected instead
  at evenly spaced ranks among the **473** shots holding all three requested
  controls. The complete original baseline remained available and was used
  unchanged; no missing control was fetched or fabricated.
- The opt-in historical reference test was bounded to its originally measured points after reproducing the new RF absence failure; this changed no production resolver behavior.
- The existing probe CLI caps requests at 20 shots. The census used the same
  FDP access mechanism in a scratch driver with four workers for all 500.
  Review caught its initial PTDATA error-to-false classification; final
  normalized results use unknown (`null`) for every failed read, retaining
  all raw errors and all 5,000 observations. The script was corrected for
  future reproduction; original raw output is also retained.
- `no_data_in_corpus` is scoped to the four confirmed-empty lithium-granule
  nodes. PCS command/status records are not delivery evidence. The brief's
  instruction to list nonempty shots and stop was interpreted as stopping
  pellet label derivation; the independently mandated actuator production
  fetch still proceeded. All positive PCS shot lists are above.
- LH stays in recorded kW; Helicon stays raw with blank units. EFC requires
  matching measured clocks and all three components rather than assuming an
  interpolation across coverage gaps. PTDATA served E-coil on all 500, so
  fallback attempts/calibration changes were unnecessary. Saturation and
  actuator labels are left to the designated later task.

## Retained evidence

All scratch evidence lives under `/tmp/lc2`; it is session-local. The tables,
shot lists, caveats, counts, and requested control hashes are retained in this
committed report even if `/tmp` is cleaned. Principal files:

- `pilot-shots.{txt,json}`, `pilot.log`, `pilot-wall.txt`,
  `pilot-summary.json`, `pilot/runs/lc2-pilot/{manifest.json,log.txt,summary.json}`.
- `census-shots.json`, `pellet-candidates.json`, `pellet_census.py`,
  `pellet-census.jsonl` (original), `pellet-census-normalized.jsonl`,
  `pellet-summary-final.json`, `pellet-verdict.log`, `finalize_census.py`.
- `wait-gate.json`, `wait-gate.log`, `wait_gate.py`.
- `production.log`, `production-wall.txt`, `production-summary.json`,
  `production-audit.json`, `audit_production.py`, `summarize_features.py`.
- `hashes-before.json`, `hashes-after.json`, `control-hashes-before.json`,
  `control-hashes-after.json`, `hash_features.py`, `protected-files.json`.
- `tdd-resolvers-red.log`, `tdd-integration-red.log`, `tdd-green.log`,
  `review-regressions-{red,green}.log`, `labelmaker-suite-final.log`,
  `live-reference-{red,green}.log`,
  `ideate-suite-green.log`, `ideate-failure.log`, `ruff.log`, `ruff-changed.log`.
- `SHA256SUMS` fingerprints the final top-level scratch evidence files.
